keep_up_with_tweets.title: Keep up with a user’s Tweets
keep_up_with_tweets.description: When a specific user Tweets, this Applet will send it to your phone during the day (between 8 AM and 10 PM) or save it to Feedly at night.

definition.description: When a specific user Tweets, this Applet will send it to your phone during the day (between 8 AM and 10 PM) or save it to Feedly at night.
definition.filter_code:
const hour = Meta.currentUserTime.hour();
if (hour >= 8 && hour < 22) { Feedly.createNewEntryFeedly.skip("Saved notifications for daytime"); } else { IfNotifications.sendNotification.skip("Saved articles for nighttime"); }

ok_google_good_night.title: Say "OK Google, good night" to get ready for bed
ok_google_good_night.description: Saying "OK Google, good night" will activate a LIFX scene and set your Nest Thermostat’s temperature.
